Daikin Industries.why: HVAC maker whose Applied business (Daikin Applied Americas) sells chillers and custom air handling units into the data-center market; data-center cooling demand drives its Applied sales and capacity additions.
Daikin Industries.evidence: Daikin Q1 FY2026 results presentation (08-04-2026): DAA Applied net sales 129% YoY, 'We expanded sales by strengthening supply capabilities and proposal capabilities to capitalize on robust demand in the data center market'; 'we expanded sales of medium- and large-capacity chillers for data centers'.

players.product: Applied HVAC for data centers: medium- and large-capacity chillers, custom air handling units and air-side equipment (Daikin Applied)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): record-high net sales JPY 1,426.8 billion (FY2025 Q1: 1,213.8 billion, 118% YoY) and operating profit JPY 130.6 billion (121.3 billion, 108%); operating margin 9.2% vs 10.0%; excluding FX, net sales 108% and operating profit 103% YoY. Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Equipment net sales JPY 1,325.1 billion and operating profit JPY 118.2 billion (8.9% margin); Americas net sales JPY 551.9 billion (118%). Management: operating profit was bolstered by yen depreciation and U.S. tariff refunds, but cost increases (Middle East situation, emerging-market currencies, additional U.S. tariffs, raw materials) exceeded initial estimates and could not be fully absorbed in Q1
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 1,426.8 billion (118%); operating profit JPY 130.6 billion (108%)
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Americas Applied (Daikin Applied Americas): net sales 129% YoY (Applied 117% on a local-currency basis). The company expanded sales by strengthening supply and proposal capabilities to capitalize on robust demand in the data center market; orders increased for custom air handling units; equipment sales were expanded by leveraging increased production capacity at its factories in the United States and Mexico, and the Solutions business was strengthened through instrumentation and engineering companies
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: North America Applied Solutions: sales to the data center market expanded in Q1, but profitability declined due to higher costs from U.S. tariffs, Middle East issues, soaring prices and foreign exchange (stronger Mexican peso), plus increased development investment; management says that beginning in Q2 it will improve profitability by fully leveraging the measures implemented to offset higher costs. Utilizing acquired companies' technologies and product lineups, Daikin is building the capability to provide one-stop solutions in the fast-growing data center market
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Applied outside the Americas: in Europe/Middle East/Africa Applied sales declined (90% YoY) due to the Middle East situation, but Daikin expanded sales of medium- and large-capacity chillers for data centers and the After Sales Service business; in Asia, Applied sales grew for data center applications, where demand remained strong (Applied 111% YoY); Japan Applied 95% vs a market of 89%
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Production plan for this fiscal year (Americas): expand production of Applied air-side equipment utilizing a leased factory, increasing production capacity while minimizing the investment burden to meet growing data center demand; also transferring production of finished SKY units imported from Thailand to the United States
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals: Q1 net sales JPY 77.2 billion (129% YoY) and operating profit JPY 11.5 billion (176%), margin 14.8% (10.9%); sales of high-performance fluororesins for semiconductor manufacturing equipment increased significantly, Daikin expanded FEP applications for LAN cables used in data centers and coating materials for high-speed communication cables used in data centers, and etching agents for semiconductor manufacturing grew (Fine Chemicals 135%)
quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries results presentation: Presentation of Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended in June 2026 (08-04-2026)
